PCB text box 'NOTES:

1. MATERIAL:
   FR408 or equivalent
   Surface finish: ENIG
   Overall thickness: 62 mils +/-10%

2. Fabricate to IPC-6012 (latest revision), Class 2

3. SOLDER RESIST: Blue LPI applied over bare copper or gold/nickel plating

4. SILKSCREEN: White

5. All vendor markings must be on bottom side of PCB

6. LOT CODE IDENTIFICATION:
   Supplier must add identifier and lot code date to silkscreen.
   LOT CODE DATE FORMAT: YYWW (YY = 2-digit year, WW = 2-digit week)

7. Drill sizes are finished size after plating

8. 100% electrical bare board test required for continuity

9. IMPEDANCE CONTROL:
   See Layer Stackup Table on this drawing and refer to ${PART_NUMBER}-PCBStackup.pdf

10. PANELIZATION:
   2 pieces per array
   Tab routing required. Tab locations indicated by ::: (see Dimensions Gerber layer)
   OUTLINE DIMENSION TOLERANCE: +/-0.127 mm
   0.25-inch rails on all sides

11. POFV: All 10-mil diameter vias must be filled using non-conductive epoxy and plated over.

12. ROHS: Fabricate to meet EU RoHS directive. Supplier must add lead-free marking in silkscreen.

13. UL: Supplier must add UL certification marking (94V-0) in silkscreen.

14. Remove all non-functional pads from internal layers

15. PCIE fingers must be plated with 30 micro inches of hard gold' on Fab Notes
